roi.$readme: minutesPerReply = staff time per reply, before/after. hourlyRate = blended cost of the person writing replies today.

faq.a: Only if you want it to. By default, every reply goes to a GM inbox for one-click approval. You can set per-dealership rules - e.g. auto-publish 5-star reviews with >90% AI confidence, hold everything else for approval.

faq.q: What happens with negative or legal-risk reviews?
faq.a: The AI flags them and routes them to escalation instead of generating a public reply. A human (GM or legal) sees them first, with the matched risk keywords highlighted. No bad reply ever ships without sign-off.
Most dealerships are live within a week. We handle the OAuth connections to Google, Yelp, Facebook, BBB, DealerRater, and Cars.com on the kickoff call. Your team only does the tone-of-voice review.

faq.q: Does it integrate with our CRM or CDP?
faq.a: Yes - we push review + response activity into your CRM via webhook (Salesforce, HubSpot, VinSolutions, DealerSocket all supported). Two-way sync available on Growth and Agency plans.

faq.q: What if the AI writes something wrong?
faq.a: Two safety nets: (1) GMs see every reply before it ships, with an edit textarea right there; (2) the AI flags low-confidence drafts and refuses to generate for anything resembling a legal complaint. The audit log shows who approved what and when.
